Entire squad mounted upon bicycles — Bicycles
Entire squad mounted upon horses — Cavalry

rules.name: Assault
rules.text: This weapon suffers no penalty 'to hit' when moving and shooting. In addition, infantry models armed with an assault weapon count as having the Tough Fighters special rule (Tough Fighters: When a model with this special rule fails to damage in close quarters against enemy infantry or artillery units, it can re-roll the failed rolls to damage)

rules.name: Bicycles
rules.text: When moving on roads, they double their Run move to 24" (cannot be used to Assault). The first time they receive any order other than Run, or if they receive a Pin marker, they dismount and abandon their bicycles for the rest of the game.

rules.name: Cavalry
rules.text: Can dismount and fight on foot as infantry, from which point none of these rules apply - need to replace mounted figures with non-mounted figures. When cavalry, moves 9" at an Advance, 18" at Run. Cannot enter buildings or board transport vehicles unless they have dismounted. Cannot gain advantages of Down, and their cover saves are always reduced by 1. Can escape as a recce vehicle (at normal speed, not double speed). Can dismount as part of Advance move - cannot remount. Can only fire pistol or carbine (treated as pistol) when mounted. While mounted, cavalry have Tough Fighters special rule (p122- When fails to damage in close quarters against enemy infantry or artillery units, it can re-roll the failed rolls to damage). Can regroup up to 2D6" after combat.

rules.name: Motorbikes
rules.text: Moves at 12" at an Advance and 24" at a Run with the same movement rules and restrictions as Wheeled vehicles, except they may make any number of turns as they move. Cannot enter builders or board transports. Do not benefit from any advantage from going/being Down. Can react by making and escape move in the same way as recce (at normal move, not double speed). Can dismount as part of any Advance move and fight as infantry, but cannot remount. Motorcycle riders cannot shoot while moving. Cannot assault and if assaulted can make an escape move as for other recce vehicles. If attacked at close quarters each man fights as infantry (including sidecar passengers if equipped). Regroup 2D6" rather than D6".

armyRules.name: Ferrea Mole, Ferreo Cuore (Iron Hulls, Iron Hearts)
armyRules.text: Any Italian vehicle with this special rule in its entry may re-roll failed Advance and Run order tests. This rule does not apply when coming onto the table from reserve or outflanking, and it also does not apply for assaults.

armyRules.name: Alzo Zero! (Open Sights!)
armyRules.text: All Italian artillery units may reroll any failed morale checks.

armyRules.name: Mixed Quality
armyRules.text: All Inexperienced Italian infantry units have the Green special rule.

armyRules.name: Defensive Strategy
armyRules.text: During the first turn of the game, the enemy cannot order their units on the table to Run as they cautiously probe the terrain in front of the Italian line for minefields and make their way across barbed wire. Enemy units in first wave are exempt and can be ordered to Run as normal to enter the table. Any of your Regular or Veteran unit that is set up on the table before Turn 1 may start the game already in Ambush. If you decide to do so, set one of your order dice in place next to them as you deploy them, as if you had ordered them to Ambush, before drawing the first order die on Turn 1. In scenarios that require an attacker and a defender the Italian player may choose if they want to be defender or not, except if both forces are Italian, in which case this rule has no effect.

rules.name: Fixed
rules.text: When ordered to Fire, fixed weapons can only target an enemy unit that lies at least partially within their front arc (i.e. within an angle of 45 degrees to each side of their barrel). Targets outside of this arc cannot be shot at with a Fire order. When ordered to Advance, fixed weapons do not move from their position, but can instead be rotated on the spot to face any direction, and can then fire suffering the normal -1 to hit for 'fire on the move'. When ordered to Run, fixed weapons that are carried and crewed by infantry teams move the normal 12" over open ground or 6" over rough ground, obstacles, etc. Fixed weapon units can never assault other units. If assaulted by an enemy, the gun itself is ignored and the crew models are assaulted as normal. Exceptions for artillery fixed weapons are listed in the Artillery section on page 123 (Any artillery piece defined as light or medium can be moved by the crew with a Run order, as normal for fixed weapons - except that these units can only move 6" rather than 12" with a Run order. Heavy and super-heavy anti-tank guns and heavy howitzers, as well as any lighter gun whose crew is reduced to a single man, cannot be moved by their crew with a Run order (though they may be rotated by way of an Advance order, as normal for fixed weapons). They can only be moved by means of a tow. Page 125 note: 'platform-mounted', 'rotating platform' or 'turntable' guns can rotate for free (no -1 movement penalty).

rules.name: Gun shield
rules.text: The crew counts as in soft cover from small arms hits that come from models within the front arc of the gun. Note that hits from heavy weapons, close quarters attacks, and any attacks that ignore cover saves also ignore the Gun Shield rule.

rules.name: HE (2")
rules.text: PEN: +2, PIN: D2 (D6 if in building) - Infantry and artillery can go down to halve the hits taken (rounded up).

rules.name: HE (3")
rules.text: PEN: +3, PIN: D3 (2D6 if in building) - Infantry and artillery can go down to halve the hits taken. 10+ hits on building collapses it and kills all inside.

rules.name: HE (4")
rules.text: PEN: +4, PIN: D3 (3D6 if in building) - Infantry and artillery can go down to halve the hits taken. 10+ hits on building collapses it and kills all inside.

rules.name: Howitzer
rules.text: Can either shoot directly at a target drawing its line of fire 'over open sights' in the normal way, or it can shoot indirect fire. When using indirect fire, a howitzer has a minimum range; when firing over open sights it has no minimum range.

rules.name: Spotter
rules.text: Cannot be placed within coherency of the weapon crew. Either the weapon crew or the spotter can be given an order - but not both. Spotters can never assault or fire any weapon against enemy units. Spotter without an order die next to it counts as Down. (Errata 6 Feb 2025: Spotters have the Infiltrators special rule - page 120. Spotter/observer can only spt for a single Indirect Fire weapon per game turn. If firing unit switches to a different spotter it resets ranging-in process.) Cannot spot for inexperienced indirect fire weapon. When associated weapons unit is destroyed, spotter is removed also. Spotters are always ignored for the purpose of victory conditions. If spotter destroyed, the weapons team or artillery unit is not affected (other than no spotter). If already ranged in when spotter destroyed, can continue firing at 2+.

rules.name: Team (3 men)
rules.text: A Team weapon shoots at full effectiveness so long as there are at least two team members to serve it. If only one man remains to serve a team weapon, then the weapon suffers a -1 'to hit' penalty. For squad-based team weapons, loader must remain within 1" or weapon suffers the -1 to-hit penalty.

rules.name: HE (2")
rules.text: PEN: +2, PIN: D2 (D6 if in building) - Infantry and artillery can go down to halve the hits taken (rounded up).

rules.name: HE (3")
rules.text: PEN: +3, PIN: D3 (2D6 if in building) - Infantry and artillery can go down to halve the hits taken. 10+ hits on building collapses it and kills all inside.

rules.name: Team (4 men)
rules.text: A Team weapon shoots at full effectiveness so long as there are at least two team members to serve it. armyRules.name: Alzo Zero! (Open Sights!)
armyRules.text: All Italian artillery units may reroll any failed morale checks.

armyRules.name: Mixed Quality
armyRules.text: All Inexperienced Italian infantry units have the Green special rule.

armyRules.name: Defensive Strategy
armyRules.text: During the first turn of the game, the enemy cannot order their units on the table to Run as they cautiously probe the terrain in front of the Italian line for minefields and make their way across barbed wire. Enemy units in first wave are exempt and can be ordered to Run as normal to enter the table. Any of your Regular or Veteran unit that is set up on the table before Turn 1 may start the game already in Ambush. If you decide to do so, set one of your order dice in place next to them as you deploy them, as if you had ordered them to Ambush, before drawing the first order die on Turn 1. In scenarios that require an attacker and a defender the Italian player may choose if they want to be defender or not, except if both forces are Italian, in which case this rule has no effect.

rules.name: Gun assembly
rules.text: To simulate the fact that the gun was actually transported disassembled, when the gun is unlimbered the artillery unit receives a pin marker. When the gun is limbered, the mule team (and consequently the transported artillery unit) receives a pin marker.

rules.name: Stubborn (Mule)
